shortBio.en: Deep Purple Mark II bass; later Rainbow bass/producer before Purple reunions.
shortBio.zh: Deep Purple Mark II 贝斯；后 Rainbow 贝斯/制作，再回 Purple 重聚。

whyHub.en: Deep Purple ↔ Rainbow personnel bridge alongside Blackmore.
whyHub.zh: 与 Blackmore 并列的 Deep Purple ↔ Rainbow 人事桥。

body.en:
Born 1945. Mark II bass on In Rock / Machine Head / Made in Japan. Leaves with Gillan 1973; joins Rainbow mid-70s as player/producer. Returns to Purple in 1984 reunion lineups.

Related: Purple–Rainbow family tree on the shared-member graph.
body.zh:
1945 年生。Mark II 贝斯见于 In Rock / Machine Head / Made in Japan。1973 与 Gillan 离队；70 年代中加入 Rainbow 任演奏/制作。1984 重聚回 Purple。

相关：共享成员图上的 Purple–Rainbow 族谱。
